AYN-NKL-LUN-GLD.short_description: A round golden-colour locket necklace with a softly striking silhouette.
AYN-NKL-LUN-GLD.full_description: Inspired by the airy visual language of Bengal’s muslin, the Luna Locket Necklace brings a calm, sculptural accent to a look. Its round golden-colour locket creates a clear focal point without demanding elaborate styling. Pair it with a simple neckline or wear it as the single statement in a layered outfit.
AYN-NKL-LUN-GLD.seo_description: Round golden locket necklace for women in Bangladesh. Discover Luna by AAYNA, styled with an editorial nod to Bengal’s muslin.

AYN-NKL-AUR-GLD.short_description: A golden-colour statement locket necklace with a distinct silhouette.
AYN-NKL-AUR-GLD.full_description: The Aura Locket Necklace takes its editorial mood from the measured rhythm of Jamdani patterns. Its golden-colour pendant lends the outfit a defined focal point, whether styled with a plain kurti or a minimal evening look.
AYN-NKL-AUR-GLD.seo_description: Aura golden-colour locket necklace by AAYNA. A statement accessory for women in Bangladesh with Jamdani-inspired styling.

AYN-CUF-CRS-GLD.short_description: A golden-colour cuff bracelet defined by intersecting lines.
AYN-CUF-CRS-GLD.full_description: The Golden Crossline Cuff draws attention through its intersecting lines and open, architectural feeling. For its AAYNA editorial world, we looked to the geometry and light-and-shadow interplay of Bangladesh’s National Parliament building. Wear it on its own when you want a clean golden accent.
AYN-CUF-CRS-GLD.seo_title: Golden Crossline Cuff Bracelet — Golden | AAYNA
AYN-CUF-CRS-GLD.seo_description: Golden crossline cuff bracelet from AAYNA. A geometric statement accessory for women in Bangladesh.

AYN-CUF-STN-GLD.short_description: A golden-colour cuff with light-catching crystal-look accents.
AYN-CUF-STN-GLD.full_description: The Crystal Stone Cuff is styled around the changing light of Sylhet’s rainy tea hills. Its golden-colour cuff and crystal-look accents catch the eye as light moves across the surface. Choose it as the main detail in an otherwise restrained outfit.
AYN-CUF-STN-GLD.seo_description: Golden crystal-look stone cuff bracelet by AAYNA. A light-catching women’s accessory in Bangladesh.

AYN-EAR-CHK-GLD.short_description: Bold golden-colour earrings with a rounded, chunky silhouette.
AYN-EAR-CHK-GLD.full_description: The rounded shape of the Bold Chunky Earrings makes a clear statement. In the AAYNA image story, the curves recall the motion and reflected light of the Bay of Bengal. The result is a simple styling idea: let the earrings frame your face while the rest of the outfit stays understated.
highlights: Sold as a pair; each earring approximately 1 inch
